objective: Harden BUKLOD Main change isolation and close accidental production OTA bypasses without touching product code
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub default main SHA 6d1a80e3d009aafcfd94444dc198cb8465e68c2f inspected 2026-11-11, existing active ruleset ID 25668992 requires objective-scope-gate but strict required status policy is false; live production OTA ID and runtime behavior not independently verified.
chosenApproach: Require exact new scope manifest for every product/workflow/script/test change; retire unguarded direct OTA shortcut and manual production dispatch while retaining marker-based frozen RC release.
selectionRationale: The existing PR regression CLI silently accepted product changes without a scope manifest, and legacy PowerShell and manual GitHub Actions could bypass RC/source identity; small governance-only patches isolate risk and preserve existing app.
alternativeApproaches: Require user instruction only and keep unrestricted direct OTA (rejected; not enforceable)
Run full Android/Web compile on every PR (rejected; expensive and does not constrain files)
Enforce scoped lightweight PR gate plus canonical frozen RC and marker-based release (selected)
acceptanceChecks: CI rejects a product, script, assets, workflow, or test PR without a new exact scope manifest.
Legacy manual PowerShell OTA throws without publishing.
Android/Web workflows cannot be workflow_dispatch published.
Existing exact-source checkout, Android frozen RC checks and main SHA checks are preserved.
GitHub branch protection setting limitation documented; no production release from governance PR.
preserveBehaviors: App features including Wall, PTT, Ads, Kingdom, Connect, Classroom and Quiz unchanged.
User data, finance, QMP, RLS, security, and Supabase migrations unchanged.
Existing production merge-marker release flow, main identity checks, RC freezing and evidence unchanged.
Existing engineering regression classifier unit tests keep pure-fixture compatibility.
